perks.name: Kickstart
perks.desc: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Plug One.1 (totalling 2) won't outclass your High-Impact fusions or your rapid fire fusions for damage or DPS but they do feel nice to shoot as their recoil is predictable and consistent. Reconstruction and Controlled Burst or Reservoir Burst are going to be the best combinations, while Voltshot and Feeding Frenzy are interesting paired together." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Plug One.1 will find its natural home in the crucible. Under Pressure or the new Lone Wolf Perk both boost it's feel and effectiveness while Slideways will boost feel pairing best with Kickstart. If you don't like Kickstart you can instead go for Closing Time which you should be at the bottom half of the mag most of the time." Recommended MW: Range or Charge Time.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Stability] "PLUG ONE has a large variety of perk playstyles that make it a little difficult to find a direction to go in. In general, you want high Stability (over Range, Stab = bolt spread), a lower Charge Time (tied to damage, so if you're not consistently one-shotting, you may need more) and either something that'll give you a constant helping hand (Under Pressure), or allow you to chain kills more easily (Heating Up). Backup Plan is great for a high-Handling build, and Kickstart for sniping as you enter into lanes. What works for you may be different to what works for others, so its worth trying out a few options." tags:pvp

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 10. PvE first choice roll for end-game content. Recoil direction is already perfect with it being a Precision frame, so barrel and mag depend on your range/stability/handling/mag size preferences. The Stunning Recovery Origin Trait can be procced when there's an anti-Champion mod in town, or externally by a grenade or melee as long as the weapon is equipped. Adaptive Munitions will shred shields in Match Game activities, with Turnabout giving you bonus shields on top. Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Stability, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Adept Big Ones or Taken Spec) mod.
